title: Order Line
description: One line of an order or a subscription: a snapshot taken at purchase. Later changes to the catalog never change it. Stored as a deck item; the deck key is the line id.
formgrid:
--- Product

sku type

--- Price

meta meta

id.label: Line ID
id.help: l1, l2 and so on. Stable for the life of the order.

variantId.label: Variant ID
variantId.help: The variant that was bought. Empty when the product has none.

title.label: Title
title.help: The product title and variant title at purchase.

unitPrice.label: Unit Price
unitPrice.help: The unit price charged, in minor units, after any price rule.

listPrice.label: List Price
listPrice.help: The catalog unit price, in minor units, before any price rule.

priceSource.label: Price Source
priceSource.help: catalog, or the id of the price rule that set the unit price.

lineTotal.label: Line Total
lineTotal.help: Unit price times quantity, in minor units.

discountTotal.label: Discount
discountTotal.help: This line's share of the order's discount, in minor units.

taxTotal.label: Tax
taxTotal.help: The tax on this line, in minor units.

taxable.label: Taxable
taxable.help: Whether the product was taxable at purchase.

interval.label: Interval
interval.help: day, week, month or year. Empty on a one-time line.

trialDays.label: Trial Days
trialDays.help: The free trial the subscription started with.

accessGroup.label: Access Group
accessGroup.help: The group this line grants its buyer, copied from the product at purchase after it was checked against the groups a product may grant.

meta.label: Fulfillment Data
meta.help: A copy of the product's fulfillment data at purchase.

metadata.label: Metadata
metadata.help: Written by extensions while the order is built. Example: {"sellerId":"42"}.

fulfillmentStatus.label: Fulfillment Status
fulfillmentStatus.help: unfulfilled, fulfilled, or not_required for a digital line that has nothing to deliver.

fulfillmentNote.label: Fulfillment Note
fulfillmentNote.help: A note from whoever fulfilled this line.

downloads.label: Downloads
downloads.help: How many times this line's file has been downloaded: {count: 2}.

refundedQty.label: Refunded Quantity
refundedQty.help: How many of this line have been refunded.
